text:
maria: Hey folks — quick heads-up. I'm OOO Fri→Sun for travel. Need coverage swaps: Sat 06:00–14:00 UTC and Sun 04:00–10:00 UTC. Can trade shifts if someone can pick one. Short handoff below.

maria: Handoff notes:
- Active: staging load-test runs Sat 02:00–12:00 UTC (expect increased queue depth & token rate). Watch dashboard: https://internal.redwood/observability/load-test.
- Known flaky: model-cache evictions on model-prod-1 — restart script: `./scripts/restart_model_cache.sh` (sudo).
- Escalation: pager -> eng-sre -> oncall@eng. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall (see rollback section).

kevin: I can take Sat 06–14 UTC. Happy to cover the daytime slot. :thumbsup:

raj: I can cover Sun 04–10 UTC if kevin takes Sat. I propose a 20m overlap/handoff at 03:40 UTC Sun for context. Any special notes about the scheduled rollout?

maria: Perfect, thanks. FYI — there's a small canary rollout scheduled Sun 08:00 UTC (5% traffic). Watch for error rate >1% sustained for 10m; rollback steps in the runbook (section "canary rollback"). Also, if you see increased 5xxs during the staging test, don't escalate immediately unless it's affecting prod.

kevin: Added to my calendar. I'll monitor the staging load test dashboard and mute non-urgent alerts. If latency > 200ms p50 or 500ms p95 for 3 consecutive samples, I'll unmute and ping here. Ping @kevin if anything spikes. :raised_hands:

deploybot: Scheduled deployment notice: `mapreduce-model-v2` planned Sun 08:00–08:30 UTC. CI: green. Notify eng-oncall 30m prior.

maria: Quick note — dev-team API quotas were temporarily bumped to limit retries during load-tests. If you see quota warnings, ignore unless you also see 5xx or sustained latency.

raj: Got it. I'll do the 03:40 UTC overlap and will request a baseline snapshot (latency/error) 5m before handoff. Can someone paste the 1-min baseline at ~03:35 UTC here?

kevin: Will paste baseline metrics at ~03:35 UTC.

maria: Calendar invites sent to both. Really appreciate the cover — thank you :pray: 

kevin: No problem — see you both on Sunday morning handoff.

raj: Thanks! I'll take notes during overlap and file a quick follow-up in #postmortems if anything unexpected shows up.
